text.p: Imo Industries Inc said on Friday the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California had awarded International Insurance Co a judgment against Imo, reinstating an $11.1 million judgment from 1995.
The judge awarded International Insurance the judgment plus interest from March 20, 1995, Imo said. Another court had previously vacated the judgment because certain issues had not been determined.

Imo said the amount awarded represents money paid by International on behalf of Imo for legal defense costs incurred in the late 1980's and indemnification payments in an action brought by Long Island Lighting Co against Imo.
The LILCO suit was initially brought against Imo in 1985 when Imo was a subsidiary of Transamerica Corp and was finally resolved in 1993, Imo said.
Imo believes the court's action was in error, and intends to appeal.
If the ultimate outcome of this matter is unfavorable, the company will record a charge for the judgment amount plus accrued interest, Imo said.
